item.title: HBX Group brings global accommodation supply to Sabre’s worldwide agency network
item.description: London, 28 July 2026.- HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace,today announced a strategic partnership with Sabre that will expand access to its global accommodation portfolio across Sabre’s worldwide network of travel agencies.

item.title: MarketHub Americas reveals the trends shaping the next phase of travel growth across the region
item.description: London, 1 July 2026 - Strong regional demand, improving air connectivity and the growing use of AI and data-driven insights are reshaping travel across the Americas, creating new opportunities for destinations and travel businesses despite continued geopolitical and economic uncertainty.

item.title: HBX Group expands its transfers offering through enhanced collaboration with Emerging Travel Group
item.description: London, 18 June 2026.- HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, today announced the continued expansion of its global transfers offering, with Emerging Travel Group (ETG) now gaining access to the Group’s transfers inventory through direct API integration between both companies.

item.title: MarketHub Americas 2026: HBX Group brings together industry leaders to unlock travel's next chapter
item.description: London, 10 June 2026 –HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace,has announced the speakers and sponsors for MarketHub Americas 2026, taking place in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, from 23 to 26 June under the theme ‘The MarketHub: Unlocked’.

item.title: HBX Group strengthens inclusive travel standards with Queer Destinations Committed distinction
item.description: HBX Group celebrates Pride Month by championing inclusivity and setting a new industrybenchmark for LGBTQ+ travel standards and education

item.title: HBX Group and lastminute.com strengthen strategic partnership to accelerate dynamic packaging growth
item.description: London, 19 May 2026.- HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, today announced a new phase in its partnership with lastminute.com. Together, the two companies will accelerate growth in dynamic holiday packaging, one of the fastest-growing segments of the travel industry.

item.title: HBX Group acquires Bridgify, combining AI and experiences capabilities to scale its ecosystem
item.description: London, 13 May 2026.-HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, has agreed to acquire 100% of Bridgify, an AI-native travel technology company focused on technology for experiences distribution.

item.title: HBX Group report shows AI adoption grows across travel distribution but scaling remains a challenge
item.description: The State of AI in B2B Travel Distribution research reveals 65% of travel distributors are already using AI, though many are still at an early stage of implementation

item.title: HBX Group reveals how the travel industry is adapting to volatility at MarketHub Europe
item.description: London, 29 April 2026.-Insights from an industry pulse survey conducted around MarketHub Europe by HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, point to a growing gap between ambition and execution across the travel ecosystem, as cost pressures and technology complexity continue to reshape how the sector operates.

item.title: HBX Group gathers travel leaders at MarketHub Europe as demands proves resilient despite global uncertainty
item.description: London, 23 April 2026.- HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, has broughttogether in Malta around 500 senior leaders from across the travel ecosystem under a shared focus: how to unlock growth in an environment defined by volatility, changing demand and increasing complexity.

item.title: HBX Group launches “Agent Radar” to help travel advisors navigate demand shifts with real-time insights
item.description: London, 15 April 2026.- HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, has announced the launch of Agent Radar, a new weekly insights feature designed to help travel advisors quickly understand evolving travel demand and identify new booking opportunities.

item.title: HBX Group brings together industry leaders at MarketHub Europe 2026 in Malta
item.description: London, 7 April 2026.- HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace,has confirmed the sponsors and the first speakers for MarketHub Europe 2026. The event will take place in Malta on 22–23 April at the InterContinental Malta, connecting key players from across the travel ecosystem.

item.title: HBX Group acquires full ownership of PerfectStay
item.description: London, 1 April 2026.- HBX Group (HBX.SM) today announced that it has acquired full ownership of PerfectStay, the Paris‑based travel technology company specialised in dynamic holiday packaging solutions for airlines and major consumer brands. HBX Group acquired a 25% stake in PerfectStay in June 2024, and this transaction brings the business fully into the Group.

item.title: HBX Group expands Marketing Suite with Sponsored Listings to power hotel growth
item.description: London, 19 March 2026–HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading independent B2B travel technology marketplace, has announced the launch of Sponsored Listings, designed to help hotels capture demand and drive measurable performance at the moment bookings happen.

item.title: HBX Group Unveils New Bedsonline Powered by AI Designed to Help Agents Sell Travel Smarter
item.description: London, 12 March 2026 — HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, today announced a major evolution of its retail solution with the launch of its optimised Bedsonline Booking engine, now transformed into an AI powered travel technology solution built specifically to help travel advisors work faster, sell with greater confidence, and offer a smoother experience to their clients.

item.title: HBX Group selects Outpayce as strategic partner to power global Fintech transformation
item.description: London, 5 March 2026.- HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, today announced a strategic partnership with Outpayce from Amadeus, to accelerate the development of its Fintech capabilities and transform how travel buyers and sellers manage digital payments.

item.title: HBX Group and Traveloka expand strategic partnership to deepen APAC supply and accelerate global distribution
item.description: London, 26 February 2026. - HBX Group(HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, hastoday announced an extension of its long‑standing partnership with Traveloka, Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform, to further strengthen collaboration and broaden the distribution of high‑quality, locally contracted hotel content across the Asia‑Pacific region.

item.title: Queer Destinations and HBX Group Launch First-of-its-Kind Conscious Travel Platform
item.description: London, 26 February 2026. - Queer Destinations and HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, today announced the launch of a first-of-its-kind Conscious Online Travel Platform (OTA) — a milestone that transforms how LGBTQ+ travellers and residents discover, trust, and spend with businesses and destinations worldwide.

item.title: HBX Group redefines partner connectivity with launch of new Partner Portal
item.description: London, 24 January 2026 – HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, has launched its new Partner Portal, designed to transform how hotel partners and clients worldwide interact with its solution.

item.title: 34% of Travel Leaders Cite Technology Fragmentation as the Sector’s Biggest Challenge, According to a survey conducted by HBX Group during the MarketHub Asia 2026
item.description: London, 18 February 2026 — Following the latest edition of MarketHub Asia, HBX Group (HBX.SM), a leading B2B travel technology marketplace, unveils the results of a survey conducted among its more than 450 attendees, including sector opinion leaders, hotels, travel distributors and OTAs.

item.title: Roiback Acquires Spanish company ThinkIN to Accelerate AI Enabled Omnichannel Contact Center Capabilities for Hotels Worldwide
item.description: This acquisition will strengthen hotel partners’ direct sales conversion and guest engagement with 24/7, 9‑language support, AI voice bots, and data‑driven quality assurance.
